title: Strong Dirac Counterexamples for All n >= 8 and Infinite Refutation of Grunbaum's 2010 Conjecture
description: Unconditional Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization in the Euclidean plane R^2 proving: (1) every n >= 8 admits a non-collinear n-point set with every point incident to at most floor(n/2) connecting lines (self-contained across all 12 residue classes modulo 12, adapting Felsner's family for several classes and adding an explicit 8-deletion construction for n = 12k + 11, k >= 2); (2) three infinite straight-line knight-lattice families with deficit 5/2 below n/2 (n = 60s + 53 and n = 60s + 69 for all s >= 0, and n = 60s + 61 for all s >= 1); and (3) a refutation of Grunbaum's 2010 conjecture G(n) = 2 * floor(n/4) by at least 2 across four infinite congruence classes modulo 60. The companion paper and its logged prior-work searches (arXiv, CORE, Google Scholar as of 2026-11-22, and surveys through 2025) are published at mathdiscoveries.org/results/few-lines-through-every-point; neither the n = 12k + 11 construction nor infinite straight-line families with deficit > 3/2 were found in those logged searches, though paywalled pages 323-326 of Akiyama et al. (2011) and print monographs remain unread/unsearched. Generated and checked by AI research agents built and directed by Tyler B. Hughes. No human mathematician has yet refereed the proof.
